subtitle: Delivery notes: from preparing a shipment to its receipt by the customer.
emptyHint: Create a shipment to issue a delivery note.

methodHints.factory_delivery: The factory's driver delivers: his name and the vehicle plate are needed before it is ready.
methodHints.pickup: The customer collects at the factory: the collector's name and vehicle plate are needed; receipt is recorded at the gate.
methodHints.carrier: A carrier delivers: its name is needed, and the waybill number if any.

fields.notify_consignee: Notify the recipient of the shipment status

formSubtitle: Saved as a draft with its note number; printed for loading once ready.
lockedHint: Only a draft can be edited; return the shipment to draft first.
customerContacts: Customer contacts: {phone} · {email} — copied to the recipient when its fields are left empty.
notifyHint: Used later to send shipment notifications (WhatsApp, SMS or email). Nothing is sent now.
transportHint: Printed on the delivery note with the driver's signature box.
linesHint: Each item needs a description, a quantity above zero and a unit from the list; width, thickness and weight are numbers.

events.returned: Not received — returning to the factory

dispatchDialog.title: Record the dispatch
dispatchDialog.text: The shipment left the factory with {transport}. After dispatch it cannot be cancelled: if it is not received it comes back as a return.

deliverDialog.title: Confirm delivery
deliverDialog.text: Enter who received the goods; it is printed on the delivery note. If part was refused, lower its quantity.
deliverDialog.partial: Refused: {items}. It comes back under a return note.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel the shipment
cancelDialog.text: Cancelling is final and is printed on the note. Give the reason.

errors.request_failed: The request could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.CUSTOMER_REQUIRED: Name the customer: choose a registered one or write the name.
errors.SHIPMENT_NOT_DRAFT: Only a draft can be changed.
errors.SHIPMENT_NOT_READY: The shipment is not ready for loading. Refresh the page.
errors.PICKUP_IS_DELIVERED_AT_FACTORY: A collection is recorded directly by confirming it.
errors.SHIPMENT_NOT_DISPATCHED: The shipment has not been dispatched yet.
errors.SHIPMENT_ALREADY_LEFT: The shipment has left; it cannot be cancelled. If it was not received, record it as returning.
errors.SHIPMENT_IS_FINAL: The shipment is final (delivered, not delivered or cancelled).
errors.QUANTITY_REQUIRED: Item {line} needs a quantity above zero.
errors.UNIT_UNKNOWN: Choose the unit from the list.
errors.SHIPMENT_LEFT_BEFORE: Its goods left once already: its items stay as dispatched. Close it as not delivered instead.
errors.LINE_NOT_FOUND: An item was not found on the note. Refresh the page.
errors.DELIVERED_QUANTITY_INVALID: Item {line}: the received quantity must be between zero and the shipped quantity.
errors.PARTIAL_NOT_FOR_PICKUP: A collection is not received in part: change the note before collection.
errors.NOTHING_DELIVERED: Nothing was received: record it as not received instead.
errors.SHIPMENT_NOT_RETURNED: The shipment has not been returned.
errors.RETURN_NOT_RECEIVED: The goods are not back at the factory yet: receive the return first.
errors.PRODUCTION_ORDER_NOT_FOUND: Item {line}: the production order was not found.
errors.SHIPMENT_NOT_DELIVERED: A customer return is registered against a delivered note only.
errors.RETURN_REASON_UNKNOWN: Choose the reason from the list.
errors.RETURN_QUANTITY_INVALID: Item {line}: the quantity must be above zero and at most {available}.
errors.RETURN_NOT_REQUESTED: The return is no longer awaiting approval. Refresh the page.
errors.LATE_RETURN_NEEDS_NOTE: A late return needs a note to be approved.
errors.RETURN_NOT_APPROVED: The return is not approved for receipt.
errors.RECEIVED_QUANTITY_INVALID: The received quantity must be between zero and the returned quantity.
errors.DELIVERY_RETURN_NOT_CANCELLABLE: Goods not received at delivery are on their way back: receive them.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than allowed.
errors.FILE_UNSUPPORTED_TYPE: Only images (PNG, JPEG, WebP) and PDF files.
errors.FILE_INVALID_PATH: The file could not be saved.
errors.ATTACHMENT_KIND_UNKNOWN: Choose the file type from the list.
errors.FILE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: The organization's storage is full: the file was not uploaded.
errors.FILE_INVALID_IMAGE: The image could not be read.
errors.FILE_INVALID_PDF: The PDF file is incomplete or damaged.
errors.DRIVER_AFFILIATION_REQUIRED: Choose whether the driver is an internal employee or external.
errors.TRANSPORT_RECORD_UNAVAILABLE: The selected driver, vehicle or carrier is unavailable.
errors.CUSTOMER_DELIVERY_RECORD_UNAVAILABLE: The selected delivery site or contact is unavailable for this customer.
errors.SUPPLIER_CONTACT_UNAVAILABLE: The selected contact is unavailable for this supplier.

productionOrder.hint: Links the item to the batch it was produced in, to trace a complaint back.

returningHint: Not received: the goods are coming back under {numbers}. Receive them at the factory, then send the note again or close it.
backHint: The goods are back at the factory. Send the note again (same number, next attempt) or close it as not delivered.
partialHint: Partly delivered: what was refused came back under {numbers}.

failDialog.title: Not received
failDialog.text: The whole load comes back to the factory under a return note; then send it again or close it.

rescheduleDialog.title: Send the note again
rescheduleDialog.text: Same note number, attempt {n}. Its items stay as dispatched; change the transport if needed.

closeDialog.title: Close as not delivered
closeDialog.text: The goods stay at the factory and the note is closed. Give the reason.

weightCheck.title: Weight check
weightCheck.outside: Outside the tolerance ({tolerance}%) — check with the customer

attachments.hint: An image or PDF, 10 MB at most: the delivery note signed by the recipient, or photos.

returns.subtitle: Goods that came back after leaving the factory, each against its delivery note.
returns.emptyHint: Returns open from a delivery note's outcome, or from a customer's return of delivered goods.
returns.searchPlaceholder: Return no., delivery note, customer or reference

kindHints.delivery: Refused or not received at the door: the goods come back with the driver.
kindHints.customer: The customer received the goods and later sends (some of) them back.

returns.newSubtitle: Against delivery note {number}: choose the items and the quantities coming back.
returns.chooseNote: The return is registered from a delivered note: open the note and choose «Register a customer return».
returns.nothingLeft: Everything delivered has already been returned.
returns.linesHint: Choose at least one item, with a quantity up to what is available.
returns.lateHint: Delivered more than {days} days ago: approving it needs a note.

approveDialog.title: Approve the return
approveDialog.text: The customer may send the goods back.
approveDialog.lateText: A late return: write why it is accepted.

rejectDialog.title: Reject the return
rejectDialog.text: The goods are not taken back. Give the reason.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel the return
cancelDialog.text: The customer withdrew it. Give the reason.

receiveDialog.title: Receive the returned goods
receiveDialog.text: Enter what actually arrived; a quantity left as is arrived in full.
receiveDialog.qualityRequired: The reason puts the goods in question: quality inspects them before any decision.
receiveDialog.toStockHint: Unless sent to quality, the goods go back to stock on receipt.

returns.qualityLater: On receipt, goods not in question go back to stock; damaged or defective goods are inspected by quality, which decides (stock, second grade, rework, recycle, scrap).

status.not_required: Back in stock (not sent to quality).
status.awaiting: Waiting for quality to inspect the goods.
status.decided: Quality decided; some parts are still being carried out.
